propositions: A plan edited mid-review currently runs all remaining LLM passes and only fails at sign time in generation.sign_manifest when PlanReviewCancelledStale is raised, wasting billing and checkpoints keyed by the stale fingerprint
The cancel predicate must scope only to own material (not relation_snapshot or ticket_store_revision) to avoid reintroducing d70a false mid-run cancels from unrelated ticket writes

The cancel signal must be out-of-band from a failed StepResult to prevent the coach/verify recovery reconstructions in produce_plan_review_verdict from converting a cancel into a findings verdict and proceeding to signing and sidecar emit

A probe placed at exactly two between-pass seams (plan_review_verify_inputs and plan_review_coach_inputs) calls own_material_changed to detect drift without store-wide reads, fetch/reconverge, or sync-lock acquisition
The cancelled verdict path returns before attest.sign_plan_review and sidecar.emit to ensure no attestation is minted or store revision advanced
With no mid-run change, existing review behavior and outputs remain byte-identical
